scopeNotes: Four distinct original bootstrap/process/reopen histories: ACCEPT or PROOF parent force, halt 73 or SIGKILL 137.
The interrupted DATA has no client success. Recovery keeps its original ENTRY bytes, reaccepts under the new ballot, then completes a fresh BARRIER before READY.
Both completed-DATA process fixtures also reran with the current producer. The earlier cold-reopen history is a reader regression against its retained producer, not a new execution.

All process observations, same original paths, physical snapshots, original wire messages and exact negatives are checked. No public runtime, autonomous competing failover or host power-loss claim. Phase 3 remains open.
